  "correction_rules": [
    "Model tends to overestimate prices in early sessions (e.g., 2024-08-08 to 2024-08-15) and underestimates in late sessions (e.g., 2024-09-16 onward).",
    "Strong positive sentiment (sentiment > 0.00) correlates with overestimation, especially in early periods; negative sentiment (sentiment < 0.00) correlates with underestimation.",
    "Model exhibits significant overshoot after price spikes (e.g., 2024-08-13, 2024-08-16), suggesting momentum bias or failure to account for volatility decay.",
    "Mean reversion is evident in later periods (post-2024-08-20), where forecasts drift upward while true prices decline — model fails to capture downward trend persistence.",
    "Model consistently underestimates prices when sentiment is negative or neutral (sentiment = 0.00) and overestimates when sentiment is positive, indicating sentiment-driven calibration bias.",
    "Lag error: model often forecasts higher prices than true outcome in the following 3-5 days, suggesting delayed reaction to sentiment or historical data.",
    "In periods of sustained downward trend (e.g., 2024-09-05 to 2024-09-18), model fails to recognize the trend’s persistence, leading to persistent underestimation."
  ]
}
